about: Run each prompt in a copy of examples/notes, with and without the skill. The notes app already shares several notes in one link (src/share.js takes a list), has no expiry, and its harden/ folder is clean.

evals.name: expiring-links
evals.prompt: support keeps asking about this: share links in the notes app live forever. make them expire
evals.expected_output: A brief in harden/briefs/ before any code: the request kept, intent with an observable success signal, sharing/revoke and sharing/read-only named as red lines, how long a link lives asked as a blocking question with a proposed duration, and no code written while it is open.
assertions: A file was created under harden/briefs/ with Status: open
The brief's Request line keeps the user's words
The Intent line has a success signal someone can observe
The brief names sharing/revoke or sharing/read-only by area/id rather than restating them
The link lifetime is an Open item tagged [blocking] and carries a proposed value

evals.name: answer-already-in-code
evals.prompt: can we let people share several notes with one link? right now you'd have to send a link per note i think
evals.expected_output: The agent finds that share() already takes a list of note ids and says so, citing src/share.js as a Source; it does not ask whether several notes per link should be supported, and proposes the smaller remaining change (if any) or none.
assertions: The answer states that share() in src/share.js already accepts several note ids
src/share.js is cited as a Source, not raised as an Open question
No Open line asks whether several notes per link should be supported

evals.name: access-full-pass
evals.prompt: our support team needs to read any user's notes to debug their issues. add that
evals.expected_output: A full-pass brief: notes/owner-edits and sharing/owner-only named as red lines at risk, blocking questions on who counts as support, read-only or not, whether the user is told, and audit, each with a proposal; Proof includes a refused case (a non-support user is refused); no code before the answers.
assertions: A brief was created with at least two Open items tagged [blocking]
Each blocking Open item carries a proposal
notes/owner-edits is named as a red line that must stay true
The Proof names a case that must be refused
No file under src/ was changed

evals.name: no-brief-needed
evals.prompt: rename the helper getNote to findNote everywhere in the notes example, nothing else changes
evals.expected_output: The rename is done without a brief; the agent gives the PR line 'Brief: none - <why>' and the tests and harden check pass.
assertions: No file was created under harden/briefs/
The answer gives a 'Brief: none - ' line with a reason
